conditions: 6 AM—Jumping right out of bed is what this doctor's gonna recommend, because our 2-week dry spell has finally come to an end. 3 inches of fresh snow fell on the upper elevations overnight, and periods of light sugar frosting will continue through the day. Mild high temperatures will top out in the upper 20s outside Corbet's Cabin and near 50 degrees in Teton Village. So, bust out your storm gear and give the springtime weather a welcome embrace because low on the mountain, liquid showers will infiltrate the airspace. Expect gusty winds from the west-southwest to help the new snow etch-a-sketch the slopes smooth as it cranks between 10 and 30 mph. Don't give up on your ongoing face-shot dreams, because pockets of pow are still sneaking in and stacking between the seams. -Lege
